record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare ACID_ARMOR: Goomy (1 star), Sliggoo (2 stars) and Goodra (3 stars). Units are bound by the queue record only; Sliggoo's and Goomy's passives are as listed in appliesTo. Hisuian forms are separate identifiers and are not covered.
record.summary: Self-buff plus a short thorn effect. The caster gains raw DEF 3/6/12/25 (by stars; AP-scaled) and registers an on-damage-received effect that lasts for its next four damage events: each time the caster takes damage from an attacker standing at Chebyshev distance 1, that attacker loses 1 DEF; the counter drops on every damage event (adjacent attacker or not) and the effect removes itself at zero. The DEF gain itself has no timer in this file.

targeting.who: the caster itself (DEF buff); later, any attacker that is adjacent (Chebyshev distance 1) when the caster takes damage
targeting.note: The strategy keeps requiresTarget = true (the base default) but never uses the cast target after super.process; the target only matters for the cast gate. A damage event with no attacker (attacker null) still decrements the counter but applies no debuff.

geometry.shape: none for the buff; adjacency check with distanceC(...) === 1 between the caster's and the attacker's cells at the moment damage is received (ranged attackers beyond distance 1 are not debuffed)

effects.scaling: requested = table value. applied by addDefense: round(value x (1 + apBoost x AP/100) x (crit ? critPower : 1)) with apBoost = 1 and the cast crit flag, then Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down, holder only) and Twist Band (only flips negative values), then def = max(0, def + value). The cast crits only if ABILITY_CRIT is active (canCritByDefault is false).
effects.resolution: requested -> applied differs by AP, crit, and a Big Eater Belt on the caster; no timer or removal of the DEF gain in this file

effects.target: each attacker adjacent (distance 1) to the caster when the caster takes damage, for at most 4 damage events
effects.scaling: requested = -1 DEF with apBoost 0 and crit false, so no AP or crit scaling. applied: addDefense on the attacker; a Twist Band holder turns the -1 into +1 (the caster is on the other team); Big Eater Belt does not boost it because the debuff comes from another team; the attacker's DEF cannot go below 0.
effects.resolution: requested -1 -> applied -1, or +1 on a Twist Band holder, or 0 change at DEF 0

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value 25 is not reachable at the bare factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined. The DEF debuff of -1 and the four-event limit do not depend on stars.

record.positionalConditions: The debuff needs an attacker at Chebyshev distance 1 from the caster at the time damage is received; attackers at range do not get debuffed but still consume one of the four events.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Each cast adds a new OnDamageReceivedEffect with its own count = 4, so recasting while an earlier effect is still active stacks effects: each one debuffs the adjacent attacker by 1 per damage event and counts down separately. Each cast also adds another DEF gain. No stored mode.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: self DEF +3/6/12 (1/2/3 stars) and attacker DEF -1 up to 4 times. Applied: the gain is round(raw x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor), x1.25 down for a Big Eater Belt holder; the -1 is flipped to +1 by a Twist Band holder and clamped at DEF 0. Damage taken by the caster is not changed by this ability's code beyond the DEF stat.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: How much the +DEF reduces physical damage (handleDamage's DEF formula was not traced for this record; see core-mechanics.md section A)
